title: Unthinking
summary: UNTHINK'ING, adjective 1. Not thinking; not heedful; thoughtless; inconsiderate; as unthinking youth. 2. Not indicating thought or reflection; as a round unthinking face.

inlines.v: UNTHINK'ING, adjective 1. Not thinking; not heedful; thoughtless; inconsiderate; as unthinking youth. 2. Not indicating thought or reflection; as a round unthinking face.
